cohort: 161 women with GDM having singleton pregnancies, without previous medical disorder and delivered at a tertiary care Hospital in Ha'il City, KSA from Dec 2020 till Jun 2021
finding: Early-onset GDM significantly increases the risk for certain maternal and fetal complications, including recurrent urinary tract infections, polyhydramnios, reduced fetal movements, intrauterine fetal demise, macrosomia, fetal birth trauma, low APGAR score at birth, and neonatal ICU admissions.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was not significantly different between early-onset and late-onset GDM groups.
